Compare two `renderSnapshot(graph)` results without subscribing to their graphs.
Values and status changes are not topology events; use `graph.observe()` for data.

## Import

```ts
import { topology } from "@graphrefly/ts/graph";
```

## Signature

```ts
namespace topology {
	function diff(
		prev: RenderSnapshot,
		next: RenderSnapshot,
	): RenderChangeset
}
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `prev` | `RenderSnapshot` | prev value used by the helper. |
| `next` | `RenderSnapshot` | next value used by the helper. |

## Returns

A RenderChangeset value for the boundary or adapter.

## Example

```ts
import { topology } from "@graphrefly/ts";
const g = graph();
const previous = renderSnapshot(g);
g.state(0, { name: "count" });
topology.diff(previous, renderSnapshot(g));
```
